CHAPTER  5

based study. J Sleep Res 2008; 17:197–206.

	74.	 Gringras P, et al. Melatonin for sleep problems in children with neurodevelopmental disorders: randomised double masked placebo con-

with autism spectrum disorders: a randomized placebo-controlled trial. J Sleep Res 2012; 21:700–709.
	76.	 Johnson KP, et al. Sleep in children with autism spectrum disorders. Curr Treat Options Neurol 2008; 10:350–359.
	77.	 Reddihough DS, et al. Effect of fluoxetine on obsessive-compulsive behaviors in children and adolescents with autism spectrum disorders: a 
randomized clinical trial. JAMA 2019; 322:1561–1569.
	78.	 Baldwin DS, et al. Evidence-based guidelines for the pharmacological treatment of anxiety disorders: recommendations from the British 
Association for Psychopharmacology. J Psychopharm 2005; 19:567–596.
	79.	 Buitelaar JK, et al. Buspirone in the management of anxiety and irritability in children with pervasive developmental disorders: results of an

2010; 4:189–197.
